Tudor Black Bay Heritage

No longer available

The Tudor Black Bay Heritage Blue 41mm M79230B 2021 Steel is a stylish and versatile wristwatch for men. Featuring a stainless steel strap in silver, a deployant clasp, and a 41mm silver case, this timepiece exudes sophistication and elegance. With a blue or black dial and round indexes, this watch is perfect for everyday wear or special occasions. The watch also boasts a unidirectional rotating bezel, 200m water resistance, and a mechanical (automatic) movement for precision timekeeping.

Complete with original box, papers, and a 2-year manufacturer warranty, having been serviced in December 2025.
